> Released under the former name **Amnezia Control**: the images and the deploy archive of this version are named `amnezia-control-*`. Starting with 2.0.0 the project is **Network Control**.

First public release of **Network Control** — a control panel for a self-hosted AmneziaWG server and selective routing of a home network through the VPN.

## Highlights

- **VPN clients** — create, block (manually, by expiry or by monthly quota), reissue keys, bulk actions, CSV export;
  configs as QR, `.conf`, `vpn://` key or a one-time share link.
- **Selective routing** — MikroTik policy routing of a site list through an AmneziaWG gateway, custom prefixes,
  "where will this traffic go" check, automatic fallback to the ISP when the tunnel is down.
- **Monitoring** — live throughput over SSE, traffic analytics, activity heatmap, connection map on OpenStreetMap.
- **Flow analytics** — Akvorado-style NetFlow analysis on ClickHouse: dimensions, stacked / 100% / lines / grid / sankey graphs,
  filter language, saved filters, previous-period comparison.
- **Security** — RBAC, argon2, TOTP 2FA, revocable sessions, API tokens, audit log; client keys, SSH key and TOTP secrets in OpenBao.
- **Operations** — alerts with Telegram notifications, in-app toast notifications and notification center,
  daily backups (PostgreSQL + OpenBao snapshot), multi-process API with leader election.

## Installation

```bash
curl -L https://github.com/sbrw-evc/Network-Control/releases/download/v1.0.0/amnezia-control-1.0.0-deploy.tar.gz | tar xz
cd amnezia-control-1.0.0
./install.sh        # creates .env with random passwords
nano .env           # AWG_HOST, ROUTER_HOST, GATEWAY_IP, LAN_CIDR, PUBLIC_BASE_URL
./install.sh        # pulls the images and starts the stack
```

Then follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/sbrw-evc/Network-Control/wiki/Installation)
to create the gateway client and import the MikroTik configuration.

Requirements: Docker 24+ with Compose v2, SSH key access to the Amnezia VPS and to MikroTik (RouterOS 7).

## Important

- Back up `openbao/keys/unseal.key` and `data/bao-init/init.json` — without them OpenBao data cannot be restored.
- `INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD` is valid only until the first sign-in; the panel asks you to set your own password.
